# Instagram
> Create an account or log in to Instagram to share photos, videos, reels, and messages with people and communities.

Instagram is Meta’s social platform for sharing visual content, messaging, discovery, and creator tools across mobile and web experiences.

## Core Platform
- [Instagram Home](https://www.instagram.com/): Main entry point for browsing, signing up, and logging in.
- [Accounts Login](https://www.instagram.com/accounts/login/): Web login page for accessing Instagram accounts.
- [Accounts Signup](https://www.instagram.com/accounts/emailsignup/): Account creation page for new Instagram users.
- [Direct Inbox](https://www.instagram.com/direct/inbox/): Web interface for Instagram direct messages.
- [Explore](https://www.instagram.com/explore/): Discovery surface for trending and recommended content.
- [Reels](https://www.instagram.com/reels/): Dedicated feed for short-form vertical video content.

## Account and Settings
- [Accounts Password Reset](https://www.instagram.com/accounts/password/reset/): Start the password recovery process for an account.
- [Accounts Edit Profile](https://www.instagram.com/accounts/edit/): Manage profile details and account settings on the web.
- [Accounts Privacy and Security](https://www.instagram.com/accounts/privacy_and_security/): Review privacy, security, and account-related settings.
- [Accounts Remove Request Permanent](https://www.instagram.com/accounts/remove/request/permanent/): Request permanent deletion of an Instagram account.
- [Accounts Remove Request Temporary](https://www.instagram.com/accounts/remove/request/temporary/): Request temporary deactivation of an Instagram account.

## Help Center
- [Instagram Help Center](https://help.instagram.com/): Central support hub for account, privacy, safety, and product help.
- [Privacy and Safety Center](https://help.instagram.com/477434105621119): Overview of privacy and safety resources for Instagram users.
- [Managing Your Account](https://help.instagram.com/581066165581870): Help articles for login, profile, and account management.
- [Instagram Features](https://help.instagram.com/424737657584573): Help content covering stories, reels, messaging, and other features.
- [Troubleshooting and Login Help](https://help.instagram.com/374546259294234): Support for login issues, hacked accounts, and access problems.
- [Instagram for Creators](https://help.instagram.com/2358103564437429): Help resources tailored to creators using Instagram tools.

## Privacy, Terms, and Policies
- [Terms of Use](https://help.instagram.com/581066165581870): Help resources related to account use and platform basics.
- [Privacy Policy](https://privacycenter.instagram.com/policy): Instagram privacy policy and data handling information.
- [Privacy Center](https://privacycenter.instagram.com/): Meta privacy information relevant to Instagram and related products.
- [Community Guidelines](https://help.instagram.com/477434105621119): Safety-oriented guidance and policy-related support resources.
- [Data Policy Information](https://privacycenter.instagram.com/policy/?entry_point=ig_help_center_data_policy_redirect): Detailed privacy policy entry point from Instagram help resources.

## Creators and Professional Tools
- [Creators Portal](https://creators.instagram.com/): Official resource hub for creators, best practices, and product education.
- [Creator Home](https://creators.instagram.com/get-started): Getting started guidance for building on Instagram as a creator.
- [Content Best Practices](https://creators.instagram.com/best-practices): Recommendations for creating effective Instagram content.
- [Instagram Reels Tips](https://creators.instagram.com/reels): Creator-focused guidance for using reels effectively.
- [Monetization](https://creators.instagram.com/monetization): Overview of creator monetization opportunities and eligibility.
- [Creator Inspiration](https://creators.instagram.com/inspiration): Examples and ideas to help creators plan content.

## Business and Advertising
- [Instagram for Business](https://business.instagram.com/): Business-focused overview of marketing and commerce on Instagram.
- [Get Started for Business](https://business.instagram.com/getting-started): Introductory guidance for businesses using Instagram.
- [Advertising on Instagram](https://business.instagram.com/advertising): Overview of ad formats and campaign opportunities.
- [Instagram Shopping](https://business.instagram.com/shopping): Commerce and shopping features for brands and merchants.
- [Success Stories](https://business.instagram.com/success): Case studies and examples from businesses using Instagram.
- [Business Help](https://business.instagram.com/getting-started/guide): Guided onboarding information for business users.

## Developers and APIs
- [Instagram Platform Overview](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-platform): Overview of Instagram APIs and platform capabilities for developers.
- [Instagram Graph API](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-api): Reference and guides for the Instagram Graph API.
- [Instagram Basic Display API](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-basic-display-api): Documentation for basic profile and media access integrations.
- [Content Publishing API](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-api/guides/content-publishing): Guide to publishing media through the Instagram API.
- [Webhooks](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/webhooks): Webhook documentation for receiving Instagram-related updates.
- [Meta App Dashboard](https://developers.facebook.com/apps/): Developer dashboard for managing apps and API integrations.

## Safety and Reporting
- [Report Something on Instagram](https://help.instagram.com/165828726894770): Information on reporting content, accounts, and behavior.
- [Hacked Accounts](https://help.instagram.com/368191326593075): Support for recovering compromised Instagram accounts.
- [Impersonation Accounts](https://help.instagram.com/446663175382270): Guidance for reporting impersonation on Instagram.
- [Abuse and Harassment](https://help.instagram.com/547601325292351): Help resources related to abuse, harassment, and safety concerns.
- [Parents Guide](https://about.instagram.com/community/parents): Resources for parents supporting teens on Instagram.
- [Transparency and Safety](https://about.instagram.com/safety): Safety-related information, tools, and policy context from Instagram.

## Company and Product Information
- [About Instagram](https://about.instagram.com/): Official product and company information about Instagram.
- [Instagram Blog](https://about.instagram.com/blog): News, announcements, and product updates from Instagram.
- [Threads from Instagram](https://about.instagram.com/apps/threads): Information about the Threads app from Instagram.
- [Engineering at Instagram](https://engineering.fb.com/tag/instagram/): Engineering posts related to Instagram systems and development.
- [Meta Newsroom](https://about.fb.com/news/): Broader Meta company news that may include Instagram updates.
